summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a revised monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in authorized and issued share capital for July 2026. The filing reports no changes in issued Class A or Class B shares, with only a note that 32,070 options were exercised and settled from existing shares held by the plan trustee. This is a routine administrative disclosure of share capital movements, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing has no investment significance beyond confirming public float compliance.
